title: Introduce client-chunk breadcrumbs and chunk-cost anchors for streaming observability
author: Maya Patel
commits: f4a3b2b: introduce chunk breadcrumb proto and serializer (core runtime)
9d2c1e7: SDK TS/PY helpers to attach breadcrumb headers and client anchors
release_notes: Added streaming breadcrumbs and per-chunk cost anchors to improve observability for long-running streaming responses. Includes SDK helpers and console dashboard. No breaking API changes.
description:
Context and motivation: Streaming responses are opaque for per-chunk cost and latency attribution. Long-lived streams (tooling/callouts/codegen) produce many small chunks, and current token-level telemetry undercounts tail latency and misattributes cost to the final aggregation span. This PR introduces a lightweight, opt-in client breadcrumb that is emitted with streaming chunks and correlated with server-side chunk spans to enable accurate per-chunk cost anchors and stepped alert attenuation.

What this PR does: Adds a thin breadcrumb envelope (chunk_id, client_anchor_hint, sequence_idx) that is passed in-stream (protocol header for HTTP/WS and as a field for gRPC streaming). The runtime now emits chunk.breadcrumb spans with attributes: chunk.id, anchor.cost_estimate, model.stage, token.count, and client.anchor_hint. OTel pipeline updated to synthesize a chunk-join span that ties chunk breadcrumbs to the parent invocation. Console gets a new "Chunk Cost" panel that shows cost/time per chunk and an orthogonal view of streaming tail latency distribution. SDK changes include helpers to generate stable client_anchor_hint values and attach them to streaming requests.

Implementation notes: Core changes in src/runtime/streaming/chunk_breadcrumbs.py implement the envelope, span creation, and a lightweight in-memory deduper for repeated breadcrumbs. SDKs (TS & PY) add breadcrumbs.ts/breadcrumbs.py exposing createBreadcrumb() and attachBreadcrumbHeader(). The OTel pipeline has a new route that tags chunk.breadcrumb spans and emits an aggregated chunk_join metric (sum token_cost, p95 chunk_latency). Integration tests simulate slow chunk emissions and assert correct attribution of cost to chunk spans and that alerts fire on per-chunk p95 rather than full-invocation P95.

Files changed (high-level): src/runtime/streaming/chunk_breadcrumbs.py (runtime span + deduper), sdk/typescript/src/streaming/breadcrumbs.ts (client helper + tests), sdk/python/redwood/streaming/breadcrumbs.py (client helper), observability/otel/pipelines/chunk-span-pipeline.yaml (pipeline rules), console/dashboards/streaming/chunk-cost-panel.json (dashboard panel), tests/integration/test_chunk_breadcrumbs.py (new integration test), docs/observability/streaming-breadcrumbs.md (design + migration guide), infra/helm/templates/obs-configmap.yaml (config knobs).

Review conversation summary: Ethan: "Nice minimal surface area. Two asks: (1) make client_anchor_hint collision resistant across ephemeral clients, (2) ensure deduper memory bound under heavy fanout." Maya: "Addressed: hint now includes 64-bit client nonce + truncated sha1 of request id; deduper switched to LRU with configurable max_entries via helm config." Lin: "Can we avoid doubling spans for small (<5 token) chunks?" Maya: "Added a threshold config (min_tokens_to_breadcrumb) defaulting to 3; documented tradeoffs in the design doc." Diego: "CI flake on macOS SDK test" Maya: "fixed race in test harness and retried CI"

CI and validation: CI pipeline runs unit tests for runtime and both SDKs, lints, and integration tests. Initial CI run showed a flaky test which was fixed in second commit. End-to-end staging test validated that the new chunk-cost panel aggregates correctly and that a sample canary service saw 8% more accurate per-chunk attribution in our test harness.

Backward compatibility and rollout plan: Breadcrumbs are opt-in by default. SDKs expose helpers but do not enable breadcrumbs unless a flag is set on requests. Helm chart adds obs.chunkBreadcrumbs.enabled=false by default. Rollout plan: enable in canaries for 2 weeks on internal beta, then gradual ramp to 50% of production traffic. Alerts: added stepped attenuation so per-chunk alerts have a higher threshold for the first minute of feature rollout to avoid noisy alerts from initial adoption.

Related work and references: ENG-4213 request for streaming observability; follow-ups tracked in ENG-4231 (dashboard polish). No linked JIRA escalations.

Merge details: PR merged via squash on 2026-02-20 after final approvals from Ethan and Lin. CI green on final revision.
